items.title: Retire the B-10 frame-link tabs (6 Hypalon 50 x 70)
items.durability: none: the bag hangs on the eight fairleads; the toggles these tabs took were removed in PR #3
items.source: analysis/bag_attachment.md (LINK hardware removed); patterns_v31.py note 'B-10 tabs retired'
items.pattern_regen: none (the v3.1 patterns already omit B-10)

items.title: Meat straps 3 -> 2 (drop IM1, keep its fairlead eyes)
items.durability: bag-off quarter loses its lowest clamp: friction hold drops from 5 to 4 straps and the hock can no longer hook over IM1; bag-on loads move to IM2/IM3 (IM3 hook already the heaviest, SF 2.71)
items.source: geometry.yaml meat_harness (IM1 cut length, hook 9 g / cam 22 g ASSUMPTION; hook $3, cam $6 ASSUMPTION); meat_haul_modes.md; DESIGN Q2
items.rec: NO. Packing meat out is the primary mission; IM1 is the low clamp in bag-off. Keep 3.
items.pattern_regen: B-01: delete the 2 IM1 ports (B-12 x2)

items.title: Meat straps 38 mm -> 25 mm (webbing, cams, hooks)
items.durability: 25 mm bites game bags and the 25 mm cam/buckle ratings were already too low for the cradle (meat_haul_modes.md); breaks the one-width MEAT family (R-25)
items.source: poly_webbing_25/38mm records; 25 mm cam 12 g and hook 5 g ASSUMPTION (no records)
items.rec: NO. Load rating and glove use beat 80 g.

items.title: Roll-top collar B-06 100D Robic -> 70D ripstop (40D silpoly shown for scale)
items.durability: tear 45 -> 35 N (40D: 25 N). The collar carries an over-stuffed load and the roll; silpoly is too slick to hold a roll
items.source: robic_100d_ripstop record; 70D ripstop ASSUMPTION (no record); B-06 cut area from panels.yaml
items.rec: YES to 70D once the materials-engineer adds a record with a real tear value; NO to 40D silpoly.
items.pattern_regen: B-06 material id only (marker re-nest at the 70D roll width)

items.title: Body face, side gores, hem, storm strip 330D Cordura -> 210D UHMWPE grid
items.durability: tear 90 -> 180 N (2x); abrasion of the grid fabric is not in its record; visible grid lines change the solid-colour look; same quietness (3)
items.source: cordura_330d_nylon66 and ultragrid_210d_uhmwpe_ripstop records; Exo users report thin pocket fabric tearing on rock (docs/research/pack_market_2026.md 3.2)
items.rec: YES if a supplier abrasion figure is >= the 330D (800 Taber cycles) and the owner likes the swatch.
items.pattern_regen: B-02a/b/c/d, B-03, B-07, B-08 material id; re-nest markers

items.title: Bag bottom B-05 500D Cordura -> Challenge ULTRA 200 (B-01 fabric)
items.durability: better: Taber 1500 -> 2000, tear 130 -> 250 N, waterproof floor (blood/wet ground); louder (quietness 2) but the floor is not brushed; stock colours only
items.source: cordura_500d_nylon66, challenge_ultra_200 records; Seek Outside Unaweep in ULTRA 200X (research 3.6)
items.rec: YES. A durability gain that also saves grams; pick the closest stock ULTRA colour (black/coyote).
items.pattern_regen: B-05 material id (and B-16 floor channels stay 500D)

items.title: Camo shards SH-02..04 on a 300D printable base (SH-01 corner stays 630D)
items.durability: SH-02/03/04 are trim on low-wear spots; SH-01 wraps the bottom corner and stays the abrasion doubler (DECISIONS: accents as functional reinforcement)
items.rec: YES, after a print test on the 300D base (camo-designer colour match).

items.title: Rain fly F-01 40D -> 20D silpoly
items.durability: tear 25 -> 15 N; the fly is also the brush cover in rain
items.rec: NO. 10 g does not pay for a fly that snags open on the first deadfall.

items.title: Fly integration: stow the fly in the SPINE band, delete fly pocket F-02 + #5 zip
items.durability: the fly no longer deploys from the bottom without unpacking; the band then holds fly + bow/poles
items.source: F-02 piece, coil_zipper_5 record; research P7 (stowable fly in a base pocket is the users' wish)
items.rec: NO. The base-pocket fly is a researched answer to P7.

items.title: Delete the fly: waterproof body (ULTRA 200 face + gores, taped seams), keep the flag sleeve
items.durability: ULTRA's film backing is louder (quietness 2, R-13 quiet requirement), UHMWPE takes camo print poorly (record ir_notes), taped seams in a 3D teardrop are hard for a first-time builder
items.source: fly rows in geometry.yaml weight; challenge_ultra_200 record; seam tape 3 g/m ASSUMPTION; owner: fly counts in base
items.rec: NO. Quiet hunting and the owner's camo direction win; keep the fly.
items.pattern_regen: all face/gore pieces and the fly set

items.title: Side-pocket gussets P-02 210D grid -> 100D Robic
items.durability: tear 180 -> 45 N on the brush-facing gusset
items.source: records; research 3.2 'thin pocket fabric tears on rock' (Exo)
items.rec: NO. This is the pain point we were built to fix.

items.title: Delete both floating side pockets
items.durability: loses tripod / rifle-stock / bottle carry and 5.8 L; wraps alone carry long items
items.rec: NO. Tripod and stock carry are requirements R-18..22.

items.title: Hydration: replace the sleeve B-09 with 2 hanger loops
items.durability: the bladder then sits against the meat stack: blood on the bladder and no separation
items.rec: NO. Meat rides in this bag; keep the sleeve.

items.title: Diagonal zip #10 -> #8 coil (2 sliders kept)
items.durability: #8 under a meat load and gloved hands; the leaders use #10 on the main zip (SG, research 3.1)
items.rec: NO. The main zip is the last place to save 7 g.
items.pattern_regen: none (tape width differs 1 mm: B-08 notes)

items.title: Diagonal zip: one slider instead of two
items.durability: lose the open-from-either-end access that makes one zip ambidextrous
items.rec: NO. Ambidextrous access is a decision.

items.title: Lash tabs B-11 Hypalon -> laser-cut TPU-coated 840D
items.durability: lighter and stiffer; laser fuses the cut edge; pull-test the 25 x 5 slot to the 450 N buckle class first
items.rec: YES, pending a 5-sample slot pull test.

items.title: Delete haul wrap W3 (crown wrap)
items.durability: the roll-top clips still compress the top; frame-only loses the top lash to the crown and antler carry
items.source: geometry.yaml haul_wraps W3; G-hook 4 g ASSUMPTION
items.rec: NO. Antler/cape lash is a field use case; keep W3.
